units.note: All coordinates in pyxl units. 1 pyxl = 10px render. Neck-local origin = spinalpoint.

spinalpoint.note: Top of neck / spine. Attaches to skull at nasalpoint. Rotation source when chinpoint is not active.

adampoint.note: Adam's apple. Midpoint of neck. 0.25H / 8.25 pyxl below spinalpoint, 0.25H / 8.25 pyxl above vpoint.

vpoint.note: V of the neck. Bottom of neckbone. 0.5H / 16.5 pyxl below spinalpoint.

shapes.note: Neck shape. Top 9w, bottom 11w, height 16.5 pyxl (0.5H, spinal→v). Neck-local coords (origin = spinalpoint).

correspondence.note: Neck keystones mapped to skull-local coordinates (browpoint origin, Y down).

chinpoint_ref.note: Chinpoint is a skullbone keystone, 5 pyxl below spinalpoint. Chin→adam = 3.25 pyxl. Not owned by neckbone.

meta.derived_from: pyxl_neckbone.json v2 — snapped to Pyxl rounding rules. Neck = 0.5H total, split 0.25H + 0.25H.
meta.changelog: anchor v2: adampoint = child (purple), vpoint = parent (green). Chin (skull) = child, mates spinalpoint (parent). Neck splits at adampoint: upper neck spinal→adam, lower neck adam→v.
meta.rounding_note: spinal→adam and adam→v = 8.25 pyxl = 0.25H (exempt from Pyxl rounding)
